oracleRisk.summary: A positively evidenced funded internal-NAV borrower branch binds the worst material tier: syrupUSDC collateral pricing multiplies its embedded MaplePool.convertToAssets rate, which forwards totalAssets to issuer-governed, upgradeable MaplePoolManager and four strategy AUM reports rather than independent collateral market marks. Block 26115263 confirms nonzero lender shares in this exact market. Current manager implementation, strategy set, governor and pool delegate are pinned; principal/accounted-interest/accrued-interest ledger valuation and governor/delegate default/upgrade discretion are verified in exact published source. This does not assert an arbitrary numerical price setter or claim that impairment alone changes Morpho price: convertToAssets does not subtract unrealizedLosses. Other seven branch tiers remain explicitly opaque pending full quality classification; a known lowest-scoring material internal-NAV branch does not create external-oracle protection, independent failover, freshness guarantees or favorable credit for them.
